Department Information

California’s Department of Resources Recycling and Recovery (CalRecycle) brings together the state’s recycling and waste management programs to move the state towards a circular economy that reduces waste and reuses all materials.

Through landmark initiatives like the Integrated Waste Management Act and Beverage Container Recycling and Litter Reduction Act, California works toward a society that uses less, recycles more, and takes resource conservation to higher and higher levels.

CalRecycle’s Mission: Protecting California’s environment and climate for the health and prosperity of future generations through the reduction, reuse and recycling of California resources, environmental education, disaster recovery and the transition from a disposable to a fully circular economy.

CalRecycle values diversity, equity, and inclusion throughout the organization. We foster an environment where employees from a variety of backgrounds, cultures, and personal experiences are welcomed and can thrive. We believe the diversity of our employees is essential to inspiring innovative solutions. Together we further our mission to protect the environment and preserve resources by empowering Californians to reduce, reuse, and recycle. Join CalRecycle to improve the lives of all Californians.

Department Website: http://www.calrecycle.ca.gov

Job Description And Duties

Under the general direction of the Environmental Program Manager I (Supervisory) (EPM I) of the Jurisdiction and Agency Compliance and Enforcement Branch, the Senior Environmental Scientist (Supervisory) will oversee a unit within Section One. The unit is responsible for compliance and enforcement related to the Integrated Waste Management Act (AB 939), State Agency and Waste Management Act (AB 75), Mandatory Commercial Recycling law (AB 341), Mandatory Commercial Organics Recycling law (AB 1826), Short-lived Climate Pollutants law (SB 1383), and solid waste laws and regulations in the Public Resources Code (PRC) and California Code of Regulations (CCR). The incumbent will provide first line supervision for Environmental Scientist (ES) staff, applying principles of scientific research, physical and environmental sciences, knowledge of statistical methods or analysis, integrated waste management and industry economics, public health, resource management, assessment, review and analysis of technical documents, review and analysis of operations and monitoring records, inspection of businesses, public agencies, solid waste facilities, and public spaces, and enforcement of AB 939, AB 75, AB 341, AB 1826, and SB 1383. The incumbent will oversee staff’s determination on the significance of violations and their general effect on public health, safety and the environment for the programs; provide oversight, training and mentoring of staff in the determination of compliance with state minimum standards while also providing technical expertise, training and assistance to staff on evaluation and enforcement matters; review findings and reports for technical adequacy; and ensure that enforcement information in the Department’s databases has been accurately input by staff. Additionally, the incumbent will play a key role in the development and implementation of new enforcement programs related to waste diversion laws. The incumbent accomplishes this by: preparing and reviewing environmental documents to determine the effects of proposed activities on the environment; developing regulations and enforcing environmental and state minimum standards; developing recommendations regarding environmental programs; preparing and editing scientific data to develop environmental policies; reviewing business/facility environmental practices; and consulting with and advising other agencies and institutions engaged in related regulation and investigations.

For more information, please see attached the duty statement.

Beginning July 1, 2026, CalRecycle staff will be office-centered, requiring employees to report to the office at least four days per week. This position may be eligible for hybrid telework under Government Code 14200, subject to the candidate meeting telework eligibility criteria set forth in the CalEPA telework policy and/or future program needs. Employees not residing in California are not eligible for telework. Regardless of telework eligibility, all employees may be required to report to the positions designated headquarter location, as reflected on the duty statement and at their own expense.

You will find additional information about the job in the Duty Statement
.

The position(s) require(s) a valid California Drivers License (CDL). You must answer the questions addressing your CDL on your application. Ensure you provide your CDL number, class, expiration date, and any endorsements and/or restrictions.
When submitting application in hard copy, applicants are required to submit a standard state application (Form Std.678) with an original signature, and clearly indicate RPA 26-012 & Position # 835-807-0764-001 in the “Job Title(s)” section of the Standard State Application or you will not be considered for the position.

jobs.description:
About Exponent

Exponent
is the only premium engineering and scientific consulting firm with the depth and breadth of expertise to solve our clients’ most profoundly unique, unprecedented, and urgent challenges.

Our vision is to engage multidisciplinary teams of science, engineering, and regulatory experts to empower clients with solutions that create a safer, healthier, more sustainable world. For over five decades, we've connected the lessons of past failures with tomorrow's solutions to advise clients as they innovate technologically complex products and processes, ensure the safety and health of their users, and address the challenges of sustainability.

Join our team of experts with degrees from top programs at over 500 universities and extensive experience spanning a variety of industries. At Exponent, you’ll contribute to the diverse pool of ideas, talents, backgrounds, and experiences that drives our collaborative teamwork and breakthrough insights. Plus, we help you grow your career through mentoring, sponsorship, and a culture of learning. Thanks for your interest in joining our team!  

Key statistics:

950+ Consultants
640+ Ph.D.s
90+ Disciplines
30+ Offices globally

Our Opportunity

We are currently seeking a Geologist
for our Civil & Structural Engineering
Practice in Los Angeles, CA
or Oakland, CA
. In this role , you will work as part of a team responsible for providing professional services in the areas of engineering geology, remote sensing, GIS, mapping, and geophysics for a range of projects involving the investigation of the cause and extent of failures of geotechnical systems and the evaluation of natural hazards. This position will provide technically challenging work with excellent opportunities to grow within the firm.

You will be responsible for

Conducting field inspections and subsurface explorations (to determine causes of failure of geotechnical systems e.g. slopes, foundations, tunnels, levees, and dams).
Evaluating and characterizing site conditions (for root cause of failure analyses and conceptual mitigation design)
Creation of Geospatial models including GIS and subsurface models
Creation of topographic maps and thematic maps
Assisting with peer review of geologic and geotechnical engineering documents

You Will Have The Following Skills And Qualifications

Ph.D. in g eological s ciences specializing in Engineering Geology or a related field from an accredited university
Alternatively, a M.S. in g eological s ciences specializing in Engineering Geology , or a related field , from an accredited university plus 5 years of experience
Ability to become a licensed professional Geologist (PG) or Geophysicist (PGP) in at least one state within three years
Experience , or related coursework in , Geotechnical Engineering, and Groundwater/Surface Water Hydrology are a strong plus
Demonstrated excellence in coursework and/or fieldwork involving geologic characterization and mapping; experience with geotechnical subsurface investigation techniques a strong plus
Experience with GIS modeling software, graphic software, and imaging software
Ability to gather information from a wide variety of sources (e.g., field investigations, document reviews, and interviews) and to synthetize and convey technical conclusions to individuals in engineering, business, and industry
Strong analytical, field investigation, and critical thinking skills
Attention to detail, dedication to quality and accuracy, desire to work in a fast-paced environment, and effective leadership skills
Strong publication record in peer - reviewed journals or conference proceedings or demonstrated leadership or activity in geologic professional societies, boards, or commissions
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Strong interest in a career primarily involving the investigation of the cause and extent of failures of geotechnical systems and the evaluation of natural hazards

Applicants are encouraged to submit a CV (Curriculum Vitae) with publications (feel free to include publications that are in review or pending) [not restricted to 1 page].

Life @ Exponent

To learn more about life at Exponent and our impact, please visit the following links:

https://www.exponent.com/careers/life-exponent

https://www.exponent.com/company/our-impact

Attracting, inspiring, developing, and rewarding exceptional people with diverse backgrounds and expertise are central to our corporate culture. Our diverse team allows us to provide better value to our clients and enjoy an enriched work environment.

Our firm is committed to offering a variety of programs and resources to support health and well-being. We believe that providing competitive benefits as well as compensation and recognition programs empowers our staff to do work that makes a difference.

Work Environment

At Exponent, we have found that in-person interactions deepen employee engagement and are crucial for development, for realizing the full potential of our talented and diverse teams, and for building a more inclusive workplace where all have a sense of belonging. In our offices, you can expect a supportive culture and a collaborative, dynamic, multi-disciplinary work environment. Our consultants engage in-person in the office unless they are traveling for client work or other business activities.

We value the rich lives our colleagues enjoy outside of work and understand that work/life balance is critical to our employees and their well-being. Consultants have the autonomy to balance their work and personal schedules so you can meet with clients, visit inspection sites, attend conferences, and make time for priorities outside of work, too. It is this flexible, agile work style and working hours that allow our teams to drive innovation and results in their own ways, while meeting the needs of clients.

Compensation

Our consultants are rewarded for their technical and business contributions and have an opportunity to plan for future success and career growth. Exponent's total compensation plan is consistent with its expectations of the quality and quantity of work performed and with the professional standards set by Exponent. At the Associate and Senior Associate level, total compensation includes base salary, bi-weekly bonuses for high-intensity efforts, annual bonus and 401(k) employer contribution of 7% of base salary.

The base salary range for this position is dependent on experience and capabilities which will be assessed during the interview process.

Salary Range

USD $110,000.00 - USD $125,000.00 /Yr.

Benefits You Will Enjoy

Access benefits information on our Life@Exponent page:

https://www.exponent.com/careers/life-exponent

Exponent is a proud equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status.

If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, you may email us at HR-Accommodations@exponent.com .

jobs.title: Senior Hydrogeologist / Project Manager
jobs.description:
Hazen is seeking a Senior Hydrogeologist with deep Northern California experience to play a key role in advancing our growing groundwater practice. This position is ideal for a seasoned professional who combines strong technical expertise with a passion for mentoring teams, building client relationships, and shaping the strategic growth of a regional practice.

In this role, you will lead and manage complex groundwater supply, remediation, and restoration projects that directly support sustainable water resources across California and beyond. You will serve as both a technical authority and trusted advisor to public and private sector clients, guiding project strategy, solving challenging hydrogeologic problems, and delivering high quality, defensible solutions.

Beyond project leadership, you will help grow the practice by mentoring staff, strengthening client partnerships, and supporting business development efforts throughout Northern California, the West Region, and nationally. This role offers the opportunity to maintain meaningful hands-on technical involvement while expanding your influence in leadership, client strategy, and market growth.

The successful candidate will thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy balancing technical excellence, team leadership, and business development to make a lasting impact on groundwater management and restoration initiatives.

Why Hazen And Sawyer

Founded in 1951 by the son of Allen Hazen (developer of the Hazen-Williams equation), we are an employee-owned company with a singular focus on "all things water."
Our work includes planning, design, and oversight of construction of environmental infrastructure – for water, wastewater, and stormwater management.
We foster a work environment low on bureaucracy and high in creativity.
We recruit talented professionals, provide them with challenging, interesting, and creative assignments, and furnish them with the tools they need to succeed.
We currently have over 2,000 employees in 80+ offices throughout the United States, Latin America, Canada, and the UK.
A flexible hybrid work schedule supports today's busy professionals.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and manage hydrogeologic investigations, recharge, and water supply projects across Northern California and the U.S.
Serve as Technical Lead or Project Manager for groundwater projects including production, monitoring, injection well programs, groundwater analysis, modeling, aquifer testing, and hydrogeologic interpretation.
Oversee well siting, design, drilling, testing, and well construction projects.
Develop and maintain relationships and support business development activities internally and with external clients.
Contribute to proposal development including scope definition, cost estimating, and technical approaches.
Mentor junior and mid-level staff and provide technical review of deliverables.
Interface with regulatory agencies (e.g., RWQCB, DDW, EPA, GSAs)

Required Qualifications

BS or MS in Hydrogeology, Geology, Geological Engineering, or a related field.
10+ years of professional hydrogeology experience, with significant Northern California project experience.
Demonstrated experience with:
Production, monitoring, and/or injection well design and construction.
Aquifer testing. o Groundwater data analysis and/or modeling.
Regulatory permitting compliance and agency coordination Northern California

Proven ability to support or lead business development efforts and client engagement.
California PG required.
Strong leadership, communication, and project management skills.
Proven ability to support or lead business development efforts and client engagement.
Experience working with municipal, utility, industrial, and private-sector clients
Professional Geologist (PG) license

Preferred Qualifications

CHG and/or other applicable licensures

What We Offer

Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision, and prescription plans)
Pre-tax flexible spending plans for medical, dependent care, and transportation
Short and long-term disability, and employer paid life insurance
Paid holidays, floating holidays, and paid time off (PTO)
Employer-contributed 401(k) plan and additional financial planning support
Professional growth opportunities, including tuition reimbursement, in-house training, and incentives for professional registration and professional organization memberships
Starting pay range for this position depends on skills, experience, education and geographical location

Who We Are

Welcome to e-STORAGE, a proud member of the Canadian Solar Inc. (NASDAQ: CSIQ) family! We’re leading the way in designing, building, and integrating advanced battery energy storage systems for utility-scale projects. Our mission? To accelerate the world’s renewable energy transition and create a more sustainable, resilient energy future for everyone.

Entity: CS e-Storage

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY:

EOS IT Solutions is a Global Technology and Logistics company, providing Collaboration and Business IT Support services to some of the world’s largest industry leaders, delivering forward-thinking solutions based on multi-domain architecture. Customer satisfaction and commitment to superior quality of service are our top business priorities, along with investing in and supporting our partners and employees.

As a Logistics & Fulfilment Coordinator
, you own the journey from the moment hardware arrives at our warehouse until it is ready for carrier collection. You are the link between inbound deliveries, warehouse execution, and outbound fulfilment. Project Managers rely on you to keep shipments moving, the warehouse team relies on you to give them clear tasks and timely information, and our customers rely on us to deliver on time. That chain starts with you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Work proactively with the Order Management team on inbound ETAs.
Brief the warehouse team before freight arrives.
Create pick tickets and shipment tasks for the warehouse team with everything they need to act.
Physically verify shipments in the warehouse. Parts present, correctly labelled, accurately addressed, nothing missing.
Confirm asset tagging and serial number capture are complete and accurate before anything moves.
Coordinate with the logistics team to ensure shipments are prepared and handed over cleanly for carrier collection.
Follow up with Project Managers for confirmed installation dates. Hardware cannot sit; you push to get delivery dates confirmed and hardware moving.
Escalate storage concerns when project timelines slip and coordinate on-site customer storage options where applicable.
Identify opportunities to receive hardware directly into customer-owned stock, bypassing unnecessary warehouse processing steps.
Maintain accurate records of inbound receipts, warehouse tasks, shipment status, and asset data.
Keep Order Management, the warehouse team, Project Managers, and the logistics team aligned and informed.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED:

A third-level degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, or a related field; 1 to 2 years of experience in a warehouse coordination, logistics, or operations support role; or a combination of relevant work experience and further education such as a post-secondary qualification or professional certification.
Hands-on experience in a warehouse or logistics environment. You are comfortable on the floor, not just behind a screen.
Exceptional attention to detail. You physically verify shipments, check labels, confirm serial numbers, and do not sign off on anything you have not confirmed yourself.
Proactive by default. You anticipate what is coming, prepare the team ahead of time, and flag issues before they become someone else's problem.
Strong communicator across functions. You work daily with warehouse staff, Project Managers, Order Management, and logistics partners.
Organized under pressure. You can manage multiple active shipments simultaneously and keep every task progressing.
Self-starter who takes ownership. If something is not moving, you find out why and fix it.
Comfortable with technology. Warehouse management systems, task boards, and Excel competency expected; additional systems will be trained.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

Familiarity with AV, video conferencing, or networking hardware.
Experience with Sage X3, Jira, or similar ERP and project management tooling.
Experience coordinating directly into customer-owned stock or vendor-managed inventory environments.
Track record of improving inbound receipt or outbound fulfilment processes.

In Esri consulting at PwC, you will focus on utilising Esri's software suite, such as ArcGIS, to analyse, manage, and visualise geographic data. Your work will involve working in fields such as urban planning, environmental management, natural resource exploration, transportation, and other related fields.

Focused on relationships, you are building meaningful client connections, and learning how to manage and inspire others. Navigating increasingly complex situations, you are growing your personal brand, deepening technical expertise and awareness of your strengths. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, and to deliver quality. Embracing increased ambiguity, you are comfortable when the path forward isn’t clear, you ask questions, and you use these moments as opportunities to grow.

Respond effectively to the diverse perspectives, needs, and feelings of others.

Use a broad range of tools, methodologies and techniques to generate new ideas and solve problems.

As a Senior Associate you analyze complex problems, mentor others, and maintain rigorous standards. Lead consulting, design, and implementation of GIS applications-based solutions
Analyze intricate issues and develop practical solutions
Mentor and guide junior team members
Build and maintain client relationships
Develop a thorough understanding of business contexts
Navigate and manage complex situations to deliver quality work

Utilize firm methodologies and technology resources effectively

5 years of experience

Understanding business processes and leveraging GIS application modules

Managing engagements and maintaining project economics

Understanding GIS Business Solution for utilities

jobs.description:
About Exponent

Exponent
is the only premium engineering and scientific consulting firm with the depth and breadth of expertise to solve our clients’ most profoundly unique, unprecedented, and urgent challenges.

Our vision is to engage multidisciplinary teams of science, engineering, and regulatory experts to empower clients with solutions that create a safer, healthier, more sustainable world. For over five decades, we've connected the lessons of past failures with tomorrow's solutions to advise clients as they innovate technologically complex products and processes, ensure the safety and health of their users, and address the challenges of sustainability.

Join our team of experts with degrees from top programs at over 500 universities and extensive experience spanning a variety of industries. At Exponent, you’ll contribute to the diverse pool of ideas, talents, backgrounds, and experiences that drives our collaborative teamwork and breakthrough insights. Plus, we help you grow your career through mentoring, sponsorship, and a culture of learning. Thanks for your interest in joining our team!  

Key statistics:

950+ Consultants
640+ Ph.D.s
90+ Disciplines
30+ Offices globally

Our Opportunity

We are currently seeking a Geologist
for our Civil & Structural Engineering
Practice in Los Angeles, CA
or Oakland, CA
. In this role , you will work as part of a team responsible for providing professional services in the areas of engineering geology, remote sensing, GIS, mapping, and geophysics for a range of projects involving the investigation of the cause and extent of failures of geotechnical systems and the evaluation of natural hazards. This position will provide technically challenging work with excellent opportunities to grow within the firm.

You will be responsible for

Conducting field inspections and subsurface explorations (to determine causes of failure of geotechnical systems e.g. slopes, foundations, tunnels, levees, and dams).
Evaluating and characterizing site conditions (for root cause of failure analyses and conceptual mitigation design)
Creation of Geospatial models including GIS and subsurface models
Creation of topographic maps and thematic maps
Assisting with peer review of geologic and geotechnical engineering documents

You Will Have The Following Skills And Qualifications

Ph.D. in g eological s ciences specializing in Engineering Geology or a related field from an accredited university
Alternatively, a M.S. in g eological s ciences specializing in Engineering Geology , or a related field , from an accredited university plus 5 years of experience
Ability to become a licensed professional Geologist (PG) or Geophysicist (PGP) in at least one state within three years
Experience , or related coursework in , Geotechnical Engineering, and Groundwater/Surface Water Hydrology are a strong plus
Demonstrated excellence in coursework and/or fieldwork involving geologic characterization and mapping; experience with geotechnical subsurface investigation techniques a strong plus
Experience with GIS modeling software, graphic software, and imaging software
Ability to gather information from a wide variety of sources (e.g., field investigations, document reviews, and interviews) and to synthetize and convey technical conclusions to individuals in engineering, business, and industry
Strong analytical, field investigation, and critical thinking skills
Attention to detail, dedication to quality and accuracy, desire to work in a fast-paced environment, and effective leadership skills
Strong publication record in peer - reviewed journals or conference proceedings or demonstrated leadership or activity in geologic professional societies, boards, or commissions
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Strong interest in a career primarily involving the investigation of the cause and extent of failures of geotechnical systems and the evaluation of natural hazards

Applicants are encouraged to submit a CV (Curriculum Vitae) with publications (feel free to include publications that are in review or pending) [not restricted to 1 page].

Life @ Exponent

To learn more about life at Exponent and our impact, please visit the following links:

https://www.exponent.com/careers/life-exponent

https://www.exponent.com/company/our-impact

Attracting, inspiring, developing, and rewarding exceptional people with diverse backgrounds and expertise are central to our corporate culture. Our diverse team allows us to provide better value to our clients and enjoy an enriched work environment.

Our firm is committed to offering a variety of programs and resources to support health and well-being. We believe that providing competitive benefits as well as compensation and recognition programs empowers our staff to do work that makes a difference.

Work Environment

At Exponent, we have found that in-person interactions deepen employee engagement and are crucial for development, for realizing the full potential of our talented and diverse teams, and for building a more inclusive workplace where all have a sense of belonging. In our offices, you can expect a supportive culture and a collaborative, dynamic, multi-disciplinary work environment. Our consultants engage in-person in the office unless they are traveling for client work or other business activities.

We value the rich lives our colleagues enjoy outside of work and understand that work/life balance is critical to our employees and their well-being. Consultants have the autonomy to balance their work and personal schedules so you can meet with clients, visit inspection sites, attend conferences, and make time for priorities outside of work, too. It is this flexible, agile work style and working hours that allow our teams to drive innovation and results in their own ways, while meeting the needs of clients.

Compensation

Our consultants are rewarded for their technical and business contributions and have an opportunity to plan for future success and career growth. Exponent's total compensation plan is consistent with its expectations of the quality and quantity of work performed and with the professional standards set by Exponent. At the Associate and Senior Associate level, total compensation includes base salary, bi-weekly bonuses for high-intensity efforts, annual bonus and 401(k) employer contribution of 7% of base salary.

The base salary range for this position is dependent on experience and capabilities which will be assessed during the interview process.

Salary Range

USD $110,000.00 - USD $125,000.00 /Yr.

Benefits You Will Enjoy

Access benefits information on our Life@Exponent page:

https://www.exponent.com/careers/life-exponent

If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, you may email us at HR-Accommodations@exponent.com .

jobs.title: People Data Analyst
jobs.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, Seattle, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly analytical and mission-driven People Data Analyst to join our HR team. In this role, you will leverage data to inform critical decisions about our workforce, improve employee experience, and drive organizational effectiveness.

You will operate as both a data expert and a strategic partner—working cross-functionally with People, Finance, and business leaders to translate complex data into actionable insights. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and wants to directly influence how organizations scale and perform.

Responsibilities

Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and data models that provide visibility into key people metrics (headcount, attrition, engagement, performance, DEI)
Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across HR systems
Develop scalable data pipelines and reporting frameworks
Analyze workforce data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities
Partner with leadership to inform decisions on hiring, retention, and organizational design
Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and clear recommendations
Evaluate the effectiveness of people programs (performance reviews, engagement initiatives, learning & development)
Collaborate with HRIS and engineering teams to improve data architecture and accessibility
Automate manual reporting processes
Establish best practices for data governance and documentation

Basic Qualifications

3–6 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or people analytics
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets
Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI)
Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets for modeling and analysis
Ability to communicate complex data clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in People Analytics, HR, or organizational data
Familiarity with HRIS systems (e.g., Workday, Greenhouse, Lever)
Experience with Python or R for advanced analytics
Understanding of statistics, experimentation, and forecasting methods
Experience in high-growth or operationally intensive environments

Why CHAOS?

Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company
Additional benefits: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more
Our Perks: Free daily lunch, ‘No meeting Fridays’, unlimited PTO, casual dress code
Compensation Components: Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses
Team Growth: 250 employees and counting across 5 global offices

$150k-$200k

Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations.

jobs.title: Technical Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Please note that this position is based on our campus in Madison, WI, and requires relocation to the area. We recruit nationally and provide financial relocation assistance.

Problem-solving with a purpose.

As a Technical Solutions Engineer at Epic, you’ll work on software that impacts 305 million patients around the world. Alongside customer counterparts, you’ll tackle mission-critical and complex problems – we’re way beyond “turn it off and on again” issues. You’ll need to diagnose the problem, identify a solution, and manage the implementation of the solution, sometimes across multiple physical locations and stakeholders. Learn more about our team at https://careers.epic.com/Jobs/Technical-Solutions-Engineer.

Test the limits of your brain for the most innovative health systems on the planet.

The top-ranked health systems in U.S. News and World Report are Epic customers. Our community includes major systems like the Mayo Clinic, Johns Hopkins, Cleveland Clinic, and Kaiser Permanente, as well as leading academic medical centers at the University of Wisconsin, University of Michigan, University of California, University of Texas, The Ohio State University, and many more.

Live affordably in a city known for its rising tech talent.

Epic is located just outside Madison, Wisconsin, the second fastest growing market for tech talent in the United States and home to the state capital and the University of Wisconsin. Madison, a city surrounded by water, has received accolades for being the greenest city in America (NerdWallet), the best city for renters (SmartAsset), the fittest city in America (Fitbit), and the third best metro in the US for young professionals (Forbes Advisor).

More than just important work
.

Our uniquely themed campus was designed to heighten your ability to get stuff done in your office, a conference room, or by the fireplace in a comfy chair. All meals are restaurant-quality but cost only a few dollars, and they’re prepared by a team comprised of kitchen talent from restaurants around the country. And, after five years here, you’ll earn a four-week sabbatical anywhere in the world. Staff have kayaked in Patagonia, attended a Beyoncé concert in Ireland, built a library in Tanzania, and run a marathon in Antarctica.

We offer comprehensive benefits to keep you healthy and happy as you grow in your life and career, and your merit-based compensation will reflect the impact your work has on the company and our customers. You'll also be eligible for annual raises and bonuses, as well as stock grants, which give you an even greater stake in the success of Epic and our customers. Healthcare is global, and building the best ideas from around the world into Epic software is a point of pride. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we know that inclusive teams design software that supports the delivery of quality care for all patients, so diversity, equity, and inclusion are written into our principles. Please see our full non-discrimination statement at https://careers.epic.com/EEO.

Bachelor's degree or greater
A history of academic excellence or professional success
Willingness to travel occasionally to customer locations
Eligible to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship
Relocation to the Madison, WI area (reimbursed)
COVID-19 vaccination

You’ll need to diagnose the problem, identify a solution, and manage the implementation of the solution, sometimes across multiple physical locations and stakeholders. Learn more about our team at https://careers.epic.com/Jobs/Technical-Solutions-Engineer.

Test the limits of your brain for the most innovative health systems on the planet.

The top-ranked health systems in U.S. News and World Report are Epic customers. Our community includes major systems like the Mayo Clinic, Johns Hopkins, Cleveland Clinic, and Kaiser Permanente, as well as leading academic medical centers at the University of Wisconsin, University of Michigan, University of California, University of Texas, The Ohio State University, and many more.

Live affordably in a city known for its rising tech talent.

Epic is located just outside Madison, Wisconsin, the second fastest growing market for tech talent in the United States and home to the state capital and the University of Wisconsin. Madison, a city surrounded by water, has received accolades for being the greenest city in America (NerdWallet), the best city for renters (SmartAsset), the fittest city in America (Fitbit), and the third best metro in the US for young professionals (Forbes Advisor).

More than just important work
.

Our uniquely themed campus was designed to heighten your ability to get stuff done in your office, a conference room, or by the fireplace in a comfy chair. All meals are restaurant-quality but cost only a few dollars, and they’re prepared by a team comprised of kitchen talent from restaurants around the country. And, after five years here, you’ll earn a four-week sabbatical anywhere in the world. Staff have kayaked in Patagonia, attended a Beyoncé concert in Ireland, built a library in Tanzania, and run a marathon in Antarctica.

We offer comprehensive benefits to keep you healthy and happy as you grow in your life and career, and your merit-based compensation will reflect the impact your work has on the company and our customers. You'll also be eligible for annual raises and bonuses, as well as stock grants, which give you an even greater stake in the success of Epic and our customers. Healthcare is global, and building the best ideas from around the world into Epic software is a point of pride. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we know that inclusive teams design software that supports the delivery of quality care for all patients, so diversity, equity, and inclusion are written into our principles. jobs.title: Senior Geologist (MS/PhD)
jobs.description:
About Exponent

Exponent
is the only premium engineering and scientific consulting firm with the depth and breadth of expertise to solve our clients’ most profoundly unique, unprecedented, and urgent challenges.

Our vision is to engage multidisciplinary teams of science, engineering, and regulatory experts to empower clients with solutions that create a safer, healthier, more sustainable world. For over five decades, we've connected the lessons of past failures with tomorrow's solutions to advise clients as they innovate technologically complex products and processes, ensure the safety and health of their users, and address the challenges of sustainability.

Join our team of experts with degrees from top programs at over 500 universities and extensive experience spanning a variety of industries. At Exponent, you’ll contribute to the diverse pool of ideas, talents, backgrounds, and experiences that drives our collaborative teamwork and breakthrough insights. Plus, we help you grow your career through mentoring, sponsorship, and a culture of learning. Thanks for your interest in joining our team!  

Key statistics:

950+ Consultants
640+ Ph.D.s
90+ Disciplines
30+ Offices globally

Our Opportunity

We are currently seeking a Senior Geologist
for our Civil & Structural Engineering
Practice in Los Angeles, CA; Oakland, CA; Bellevue, WA;
or Seattle, WA
.
In this role you will work as part of a team responsible for providing professional services in the areas of engineering geology, remote sensing, GIS, mapping, and geophysics for a range of projects involving the investigation of the cause and extent of failures of geotechnical systems and the evaluation of natural hazards. This position will provide technically challenging work with excellent opportunities to grow within the firm.

You will be responsible for

Conducting field inspections and subsurface explorations (to determine causes of failure of geotechnical systems e.g. slopes, foundations, tunnels, levees, and dams).
Evaluating and characterizing site conditions (for root cause of failure analyses and conceptual mitigation design)
Creation of Geospatial models including GIS and subsurface models
Creation of topographic maps and thematic maps
Assisting with peer review of geologic and geotechnical engineering documents
Evaluating construction claims
Preparation of technical reports

You Will Have The Following Skills And Qualifications

Ph.D. in g eological s ciences specializing in Engineering Geology, or a related field, from an accredited university plus 3 years of experience
Alternatively, a M.S. in geological sciences, specializing in Engineering Geology, or a related field, from an accredited university, plus 5 years of experience
Licensed professional Geologist (PG) or Geophysicist (PGP) in at least one state in at least one state is required
Ability to become a Certified Engineering Geologist (CEG) or Certified Hydrogeologist (CHG) in at least one state
Demonstrated excellence in coursework and/or fieldwork involving geologic characterization and mapping; experience with geotechnical subsurface investigation techniques a strong plus
Ability to work independently or support multiple group projects and to interact with other engineers, scientists, administrative staff, and clients
Degrees, experience, or related coursework in Geotechnical Engineering, and Groundwater/Surface Water Hydrology are a strong plus
Experience with GIS modeling software, graphic software, and imaging software is a strong plus
Ability to gather information from a wide variety of sources (e.g., field investigations, document reviews, and interviews) and to synthetize and convey technical conclusions to individuals in engineering, business, and industry
Strong analytical, field investigation, and critical thinking skills
Attention to detail, dedication to quality and accuracy, desire to work in a fast-paced environment, and effective leadership skills
Strong publication record in peer reviewed journals or conference proceedings or demonstrated leadership or activity in professional societies, boards, or commissions
Record of excellent written and verbal communication skills
Strong interest in a career primarily involving the investigation of the cause and extent of failures of geotechnical systems and the evaluation of natural hazards.

Applicants are encouraged to submit a CV (Curriculum Vitae) with publications (feel free to include publications that are in review or pending) [not restricted to 1 page].

Life @ Exponent

To learn more about life at Exponent and our impact, please visit the following links:

https://www.exponent.com/careers/life-exponent

https://www.exponent.com/company/our-impact

Attracting, inspiring, developing, and rewarding exceptional people with diverse backgrounds and expertise are central to our corporate culture. Our diverse team allows us to provide better value to our clients and enjoy an enriched work environment.

Our firm is committed to offering a variety of programs and resources to support health and well-being. We believe that providing competitive benefits as well as compensation and recognition programs empowers our staff to do work that makes a difference.

Work Environment

At Exponent, we have found that in-person interactions deepen employee engagement and are crucial for development, for realizing the full potential of our talented and diverse teams, and for building a more inclusive workplace where all have a sense of belonging. In our offices, you can expect a supportive culture and a collaborative, dynamic, multi-disciplinary work environment. Our consultants engage in-person in the office unless they are traveling for client work or other business activities.

We value the rich lives our colleagues enjoy outside of work and understand that work/life balance is critical to our employees and their well-being. Consultants have the autonomy to balance their work and personal schedules so you can meet with clients, visit inspection sites, attend conferences, and make time for priorities outside of work, too. It is this flexible, agile work style and working hours that allow our teams to drive innovation and results in their own ways, while meeting the needs of clients.

Compensation

Our consultants are rewarded for their technical and business contributions and have an opportunity to plan for future success and career growth. Exponent's total compensation plan is consistent with its expectations of the quality and quantity of work performed and with the professional standards set by Exponent. At the Associate and Senior Associate level, total compensation includes base salary, bi-weekly bonuses for high-intensity efforts, annual bonus and 401(k) employer contribution of 7% of base salary.

The base salary range for this position is dependent on experience and capabilities which will be assessed during the interview process.

Salary Range

USD $115,000.00 - USD $135,000.00 /Yr.

Benefits You Will Enjoy

Access benefits information on our Life@Exponent page:

https://www.exponent.com/careers/life-exponent

Exponent is a proud equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status.

If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, you may email us at HR-Accommodations@exponent.com .

Stay updated with the latest industry trends and best practices in solar technology and maintenance techniques.

Join NextEra's Power Generation Team

Reliability engineering
Warranty management

Safety and Environmental program stewardship
Supervisory duties of NEE employees and contractors

Business duties and Inventory management

Experience: 0+ years
Valid Driver's License (NON CDL)

Trade School Graduate
Licensed Electrician

Six Sigma Yellow Belt Certified

jobs.title: Project Coordinator (CAPC-01)
jobs.description:
MEA Forensic Engineers & Scientists is seeking a Project Coordinator to join our engineering support team working full-time in-person at our Laguna Hills, CA office. In a fast-paced and challenging environment, this role requires initiative, strong attention to detail, professionalism, resourcefulness, and the ability to multi-task.

MEA Forensic is an equal opportunity employer. The position is onsite, in our Orange County, California office. The annual salary is $60,000 to $80,000 depending on skill and experience. We contribute $1000 per month towards healthcare plan premiums (medical, dental, vision) and offer a safe harbor 401(k) plan. Starting vacation is 3 weeks (accrued annually) and we observe 12 paid holidays per year.

Role and Responsibilities

Project administration: Record initial instructions from clients; perform conflict searches; coordinate initial activities and prepare confidential documents; assist with report preparation (reviewing, formatting and editing); complete billing process for each file; deal with client queries (invoicing).
Project management: Track progress and status of all active files; maintain awareness of Engineers’ workloads, specializations, schedules, and deadlines. Attend weekly team meetings.
Communication & Teamwork:
Communicate with Engineers, Project Coordinators, and clients regarding project activities and status; develop good working relationships with all Engineers, other Project Administrators/Coordinators, and other personnel at the firm.
General administration: Handle incoming inquiries, mail distribution, reception (couriers, visitors), logging of checks, and other duties, as required.
Specialized tasks:
Create reports; conduct library and archival research; purchase materials for testing; handle evidence and follow procedures for proper storage and documentation; coordinate evidence examinations, events and travel arrangements. Process inspection photos/data; maintain MEA equipment; and be available for ad hoc requests.

Required Qualifications

Minimum 2 years’ experience working in an administrative role
Strong oral and written English
Intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, online research
Typing and data entry
Ability to lift up to 40 lbs
Current driver’s license

Preferred Qualifications

Post-secondary education
Strong oral and written Spanish
Legal/Investigative background

To apply

Referencing the job title and posting number, please email your resume and cover letter to careersus@meaforensic.com.

Company Overview

MEA Forensic is a multi-disciplinary forensic investigation firm that specializes in collision reconstruction, injury biomechanics, product and material failures, human factors, and aviation accidents for the legal and insurance industries. It is challenging work that is intensely scrutinized in a court of law and often under rigid deadlines; it is also varied, exciting, and highly rewarding.

At MEA, we provide our staff with a stimulating, collaborative environment and extensive formal and informal training. Our salary, culture and benefits are designed to attract and keep bright, high-achieving professionals.

jobs.title: Teen Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Make an impact in the lives of youth in beautiful Santa Monica!

Job Description

Under the direction of the Youth Development Director, the Teen Coordinator is responsible for planning, coordinating, and facilitating engaging, safe, and inclusive programs for teens ages 12–17. This role supports the YMCA's mission by promoting youth development, leadership, academic success, healthy lifestyles, and community engagement. The Teen Coordinator serves as a positive role model, mentor, and advocate for teens while building strong relationships with families, schools, and community partners.

Qualifications

Must be at least 21 years of age.
A minimum of one year working with teens (ages 12-17).
A minimum of six months related program development and/or program management experience.
Previous experience working with diverse populations preferred.
Possess excellent written and verbal communication skills to work cohesively with parents, participants and staff.
Demonstrated computer skills in a Google Workspace
CPR/AED, and First Aid Certification, must include Adult and Child/Infant, obtained within 30 days of hire and must be from one of the following certifying organizations:
American Red Cross
American Heart Association
American Safety & Health Institute

Essential Functions

Plan, coordinate, and facilitate engaging, safe, and inclusive teen programs for youth ages 12-17.
Support youth leadership development by mentoring teens, encouraging youth voice, and promoting teamwork, responsibility, and confidence.
Serve as the Lead Advisor for the YMCA's Model United Nations and Youth & Government programs, including weekly meetings, curriculum facilitation, and preparation for conferences, simulations, and civic engagement events.
Ensure the safety and well-being of all participants by following YMCA policies, maintaining appropriate supervision ratios, and implementing positive behavior management strategies.
Host surveys to gauge teen, parent, and community interest. Determine needs of the community to make program decisions.
Plan, develop and implement relevant programs and workshops to engage teen participation.
Build strong relationships with teens, parents/guardians, school staff, and community partners.
Communicate program updates and participant progress to families in a timely and professional manner.
Plan and lead Teen Camps for the Santa Monica Family YMCA during Spring/Summer and Mini-Day Camps.
Serve as admin liaison for Camp Big Bear (Summer Camp). Assist with administrative duties such as registration questions, managing questions, setting up rooms for training/parent meetings and assisting with Check-in and Check-out Days.
Develop, plan and implement a teen volunteer program to promote community engagement.
Assist with program promotion, outreach, and participant recruitment. Work with Marketing to promote programs in a timely manner in order to meet program enrollment goals.
Maintain accurate attendance records, incident reports, and required program documentation.
Collaborate with YMCA staff, volunteers, interns, and community partners to support high-quality programming.
Participate in staff meetings, trainings, conferences, and YMCA events as required.
Model and uphold the YMCA core values of Caring, Honesty, Respect, and Responsibility at all times.
Ensure that teen programming attains the highest standards as established by the Santa Monica Family YMCA.
Assist in association-wide initiatives such as Healthy Kids Day, Spooktacular, Winter Wonderland and others.
Other duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Senior Geologist (MS/PhD)
jobs.description:
About Exponent

Exponent
is the only premium engineering and scientific consulting firm with the depth and breadth of expertise to solve our clients’ most profoundly unique, unprecedented, and urgent challenges.

Our vision is to engage multidisciplinary teams of science, engineering, and regulatory experts to empower clients with solutions that create a safer, healthier, more sustainable world. For over five decades, we've connected the lessons of past failures with tomorrow's solutions to advise clients as they innovate technologically complex products and processes, ensure the safety and health of their users, and address the challenges of sustainability.

Join our team of experts with degrees from top programs at over 500 universities and extensive experience spanning a variety of industries. At Exponent, you’ll contribute to the diverse pool of ideas, talents, backgrounds, and experiences that drives our collaborative teamwork and breakthrough insights. Plus, we help you grow your career through mentoring, sponsorship, and a culture of learning. Thanks for your interest in joining our team!  

Key statistics:

950+ Consultants
640+ Ph.D.s
90+ Disciplines
30+ Offices globally

Our Opportunity

We are currently seeking a Senior Geologist
for our Civil & Structural Engineering
Practice in Los Angeles, CA; Oakland, CA; Bellevue, WA;
or Seattle, WA
.
In this role you will work as part of a team responsible for providing professional services in the areas of engineering geology, remote sensing, GIS, mapping, and geophysics for a range of projects involving the investigation of the cause and extent of failures of geotechnical systems and the evaluation of natural hazards. This position will provide technically challenging work with excellent opportunities to grow within the firm.

You will be responsible for

Conducting field inspections and subsurface explorations (to determine causes of failure of geotechnical systems e.g. slopes, foundations, tunnels, levees, and dams).
Evaluating and characterizing site conditions (for root cause of failure analyses and conceptual mitigation design)
Creation of Geospatial models including GIS and subsurface models
Creation of topographic maps and thematic maps
Assisting with peer review of geologic and geotechnical engineering documents
Evaluating construction claims
Preparation of technical reports

You Will Have The Following Skills And Qualifications

Ph.D. in g eological s ciences specializing in Engineering Geology, or a related field, from an accredited university plus 3 years of experience
Alternatively, a M.S. in geological sciences, specializing in Engineering Geology, or a related field, from an accredited university, plus 5 years of experience
Licensed professional Geologist (PG) or Geophysicist (PGP) in at least one state in at least one state is required
Ability to become a Certified Engineering Geologist (CEG) or Certified Hydrogeologist (CHG) in at least one state
Demonstrated excellence in coursework and/or fieldwork involving geologic characterization and mapping; experience with geotechnical subsurface investigation techniques a strong plus
Ability to work independently or support multiple group projects and to interact with other engineers, scientists, administrative staff, and clients
Degrees, experience, or related coursework in Geotechnical Engineering, and Groundwater/Surface Water Hydrology are a strong plus
Experience with GIS modeling software, graphic software, and imaging software is a strong plus
Ability to gather information from a wide variety of sources (e.g., field investigations, document reviews, and interviews) and to synthetize and convey technical conclusions to individuals in engineering, business, and industry
Strong analytical, field investigation, and critical thinking skills
Attention to detail, dedication to quality and accuracy, desire to work in a fast-paced environment, and effective leadership skills
Strong publication record in peer reviewed journals or conference proceedings or demonstrated leadership or activity in professional societies, boards, or commissions
Record of excellent written and verbal communication skills
Strong interest in a career primarily involving the investigation of the cause and extent of failures of geotechnical systems and the evaluation of natural hazards.

Applicants are encouraged to submit a CV (Curriculum Vitae) with publications (feel free to include publications that are in review or pending) [not restricted to 1 page].

Life @ Exponent

To learn more about life at Exponent and our impact, please visit the following links:

https://www.exponent.com/careers/life-exponent

https://www.exponent.com/company/our-impact

Attracting, inspiring, developing, and rewarding exceptional people with diverse backgrounds and expertise are central to our corporate culture. Our diverse team allows us to provide better value to our clients and enjoy an enriched work environment.

Our firm is committed to offering a variety of programs and resources to support health and well-being. We believe that providing competitive benefits as well as compensation and recognition programs empowers our staff to do work that makes a difference.

Work Environment

At Exponent, we have found that in-person interactions deepen employee engagement and are crucial for development, for realizing the full potential of our talented and diverse teams, and for building a more inclusive workplace where all have a sense of belonging. In our offices, you can expect a supportive culture and a collaborative, dynamic, multi-disciplinary work environment. Our consultants engage in-person in the office unless they are traveling for client work or other business activities.

We value the rich lives our colleagues enjoy outside of work and understand that work/life balance is critical to our employees and their well-being. Consultants have the autonomy to balance their work and personal schedules so you can meet with clients, visit inspection sites, attend conferences, and make time for priorities outside of work, too. It is this flexible, agile work style and working hours that allow our teams to drive innovation and results in their own ways, while meeting the needs of clients.

Compensation

Our consultants are rewarded for their technical and business contributions and have an opportunity to plan for future success and career growth. Exponent's total compensation plan is consistent with its expectations of the quality and quantity of work performed and with the professional standards set by Exponent. At the Associate and Senior Associate level, total compensation includes base salary, bi-weekly bonuses for high-intensity efforts, annual bonus and 401(k) employer contribution of 7% of base salary.

The base salary range for this position is dependent on experience and capabilities which will be assessed during the interview process.

Salary Range

USD $115,000.00 - USD $135,000.00 /Yr.

Benefits You Will Enjoy

Access benefits information on our Life@Exponent page:

https://www.exponent.com/careers/life-exponent

Exponent is a proud equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status.

If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, you may email us at HR-Accommodations@exponent.com .

jobs.title: Technical Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Please note that this position is based on our campus in Madison, WI, and requires relocation to the area. We recruit nationally and provide financial relocation assistance.

Problem-solving with a purpose.

As a Technical Solutions Engineer at Epic, you’ll work on software that impacts 305 million patients around the world. Alongside customer counterparts, you’ll tackle mission-critical and complex problems – we’re way beyond “turn it off and on again” issues. You’ll need to diagnose the problem, identify a solution, and manage the implementation of the solution, sometimes across multiple physical locations and stakeholders. Learn more about our team at https://careers.epic.com/Jobs/Technical-Solutions-Engineer.

Test the limits of your brain for the most innovative health systems on the planet.

The top-ranked health systems in U.S. News and World Report are Epic customers. Our community includes major systems like the Mayo Clinic, Johns Hopkins, Cleveland Clinic, and Kaiser Permanente, as well as leading academic medical centers at the University of Wisconsin, University of Michigan, University of California, University of Texas, The Ohio State University, and many more.

Live affordably in a city known for its rising tech talent.

Epic is located just outside Madison, Wisconsin, the second fastest growing market for tech talent in the United States and home to the state capital and the University of Wisconsin. Madison, a city surrounded by water, has received accolades for being the greenest city in America (NerdWallet), the best city for renters (SmartAsset), the fittest city in America (Fitbit), and the third best metro in the US for young professionals (Forbes Advisor).

More than just important work
.

Our uniquely themed campus was designed to heighten your ability to get stuff done in your office, a conference room, or by the fireplace in a comfy chair. All meals are restaurant-quality but cost only a few dollars, and they’re prepared by a team comprised of kitchen talent from restaurants around the country. And, after five years here, you’ll earn a four-week sabbatical anywhere in the world. Staff have kayaked in Patagonia, attended a Beyoncé concert in Ireland, built a library in Tanzania, and run a marathon in Antarctica.

We offer comprehensive benefits to keep you healthy and happy as you grow in your life and career, and your merit-based compensation will reflect the impact your work has on the company and our customers. You'll also be eligible for annual raises and bonuses, as well as stock grants, which give you an even greater stake in the success of Epic and our customers. Healthcare is global, and building the best ideas from around the world into Epic software is a point of pride. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we know that inclusive teams design software that supports the delivery of quality care for all patients, so diversity, equity, and inclusion are written into our principles. Please see our full non-discrimination statement at https://careers.epic.com/EEO.

Bachelor's degree or greater
A history of academic excellence or professional success
Willingness to travel occasionally to customer locations
Eligible to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship
Relocation to the Madison, WI area (reimbursed)
COVID-19 vaccination

jobs.title: Topobathymetric Lidar Geospatial Analyst II
jobs.description:
Job Description

Dewberry is currently seeking a Geospatial Analyst III
for our Fairfax, VA or
Tampa, FL
office. Remote positions
will be considered dependent on experience. This is an excellent career opportunity for an individual to join a team of professionals while working in a multidisciplinary consulting and engineering firm. The firm succeeds through the individual and collaborative skills of its people therefore we offer opportunities for professional growth while working with and applying the latest technology. Typical responsibilities are to work on the GIS/IT and Remote Sensing related projects for state and federal clients across the US. Overall responsibility includes working on a team performing automated and manual processing of point cloud data.

Dewberry is a leading, market-facing professional services firm with more than 60 locations and 2,500 professionals nationwide. What sets us apart from our competitors are our people. At Dewberry, we seek out exceptional talent and strive to deliver the highest quality of services to our clients. Whether you’re an experienced professional or a new graduate, you’ll have the chance to collaborate with the best and brightest and work on innovative and complex projects at the forefront of the industry. Our commitment to excellence stems from our integrity and from other defining attributes, which we call “Dewberry at Work,” that have inspired our employees to be successful for more than a half-century.

Responsibilities

Position requires experience in analysis and review of topographic lidar data, topobathymetric data, vector data (2D and 3D), Digital Elevation Models (DEMs), Digital Surface Models (DSMs), imagery, and derivative products for state, federal, and private clients across the US. Experience with creating automated lidar classification algorithms (TerraSolid Products) preferred. Strong candidates will also have a good, conceptual understanding of fundamental remote sensing concepts and geospatial processes for various products, e.g. how lidar sensors work, basic GPS ground survey procedures, airborne lidar trajectory processing, interaction of light and water for bathymetry applications, and ortho-imagery processing.

Working with the initial processing and data classification of multiple topographic and bathymetric lidar projects
Creating Scripts/Models/Macros in multiple sensor platforms
Work with the Product Line Lead to assist in the execution of projects, on time and within budget
Data Management and Handling: Planning and monitoring production data, management needs and working with IT and Operations to ensure adequate resources are available; Ensuring data management protocols are met including the use of proper files and formats as well as file locations, storage, and backups
Perform work that appropriately follows all quality control steps and practices are implemented throughout processes to ensure deliverables meet client specifications
Provide feedback and support for developing and/or updating SOPs as necessary
Works with production staff to support process improvements; working with other Technology/Process Improvement teams to review best practices to enhance product line, gain efficiencies, and improve quality
Support improvements to automation of the production and QC process through providing technical guidance and ideas
Task Management; Problem resolution; Report writing; Collaboration
Quality Assurance, documentation and providing feedback

Required Skills & Required Experience

Required Skills and Experience

Bachelor's degree in Geography, GIS, or related field.
3 +years of experience in the GIS/Remote Sensing Field or equivalent combination of education and experience with a focus on point cloud classification working with Lidar and producing other Elevation data sources
Experience in Lidar processing and elevation model creation/manipulation, hydrography, or other remote sensing processing, development, and QA/QC
An understanding of GIS and Lidar data and concepts including a strong knowledge of various raster and vector data types, coordinate systems, projections, and datums
Understanding of Lidar production workflow and being able to explain the conceptual basis of Lidar acquisition, processing, and deliverable creation
The ability to analyze point clouds and various geospatial data layers derived from point cloud data
Working experience with Terrasolid Products and MicroStation
In-depth knowledge of ESRI’s products including ArcGIS 10x, ArcPro.
Proficiency in basic computer applications, especially MS Office (Word, Excel, and Access)
Ability to handle multiple priorities under tight schedules as required
Strong verbal and written communication skills

Beneficial Skills & Experience

Creative problem-solving skills.
GISP Certification, ASPRS certifications in Lidar or other Remote Sensing technologies a plus
LASTools, LP360, Global Mapper, QGIS experience a plus
Working knowledge of Python and/or other programming languages a plus
GDAL Tools, and command line applications highly desirable
ArcGIS Data Review and Production Editing experience a plus
Specific experience working with Riegl topobathymetric sensors and Optech CZMIL topobathymetric sensors
Experience creating scripts/models/macros in multiple GIS/remote sensing platforms
Experience with national elevation programs, such as NOAA’s Coastal Mapping Program, USGS 3DEP, and/or USGS 3DHP
Experience with industry standards and specifications, e.g., ASPRS Positional accuracy Standards for Digital Geospatial Data, USGS Lidar Base Specifications

Additional Requirements

US Citizen

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Dewberry we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace for our employees. So, if you’re excited about this role, but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the position description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may just be the right candidate for this or other opportunities.

About Us

HBK Engineering, LLC is a fully licensed, professional engineering design firm headquartered in Chicago, IL with a staff approaching 700 individuals. HBK provides civil, environmental, structural, electrical, subsurface utility, construction support services and permitting facilitation. Since our founding in 1998, we have earned a reputation for delivering outstanding, accurate services in extremely time-sensitive, multilayered environments. That "industry-recognized" performance has propelled our expansion and the ability to provide engineering services in all 50 states. With 25 offices nationwide, including concentrations in the Midwest and on the Coasts, HBK brings together a dedicated team whose main focus is the design and protection of utilities and utility networks. We have successfully performed engineering work for a complete spectrum of utility infrastructure projects providing solutions and construction support from Coast to Coast in areas ranging from complex urban city centers, to rural greenfields, to limited access rights-of-way. In July 2020, HBK Engineering was acquired by Quanta Services. Quanta Services provides infrastructure services for electric power, pipeline, and communications industries and employees over 50,000 people. Quanta’s focus on the utility industry and HBK’s focus on constructability in our designs has made our integration into the Quanta family of companies seamless.

About This Role

HBK Engineering is seeking a Field Lead, who performs all duties of a Field Lead with greater responsibility, independence, and technical judgment. This role often includes interpreting survey plans, resolving field issues, coordinating with project managers or engineers, mentoring junior staff, and making on-site decisions that affect survey accuracy and efficiency. Senior Field Leads frequently handle complex boundaries, control, or construction surveys and may serve as the primary field liaison for clients or agencies. Work location Texas

Heavy Civil Survey Construction Layout and Data Collection, including data centers, substations and BESS facilities.

Aerial and/or underground OSP construction experience.

Working@AIS

jobs.description:
Site: The General Hospital Corporation

Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.

Job Summary

The Division for Neuropsychiatry and Neuromodulation at the Massachusetts General Hospital, Harvard Medical School, is seeking a full time Data Analyst for a series of exciting large-scale projects aimed at understanding circuit dynamics underlying neuropsychiatric disorders and their treatments. The laboratory is a multidisciplinary group conducting clinical, translational and basic human neuroscience research with healthy and neuropsychiatric populations, using device-based neuromodulation interventions (TMS, tDCS, ECT, DBS, etc.), neuroimaging, EEG, behavioral and clinical methods. The program includes the Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS) clinical service, tightly integrated with our research mission, where we provide individualized treatments for neuropsychiatric patients.

Qualifications

Duties and Responsibilities

The Data Analyst responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

Implement and support statistical analyses, machine learning models, and processing pipelines/scripts for behavioral, EEG and multimodal neuroimaging analysis, including resting‐state and task-based fMRI, DTI and volumetric data.
Assist in the creation of databases, query tools for data mining, and documentation on their effective use. Behavioral (RedCap, etc.) and neuroimaging databases (BIDS, XNAT, etc.) are emphasized.
Maintain quality control and integrity of neuroimaging and behavioral data by developing, implementing and overseeing data entry and QC protocols.
Implement web-based behavioral questionnaires (e.g. RedCap) and program behavioral tasks with presentation software (e.g. Psychophysics Toolbox, PsychoPy, Presentation).
Provide programming and analysis support for lab members.
Coordinate general lab computer/network administration (including data management and archiving).
Assist with the preparation of scientific reports and publications.
Provide technical and logistical support for in-person study visits (data collection) as needed.
Provide training and backup support for CRCs on various projects as needed.

Qualifications:

B.A., B.S. or equivalent with background in neuroscience, computer science, engineering or related fields. Masters or PhD degree preferred but not required. 2+ years of prior technical experience.
Proficient with multiple neuroimaging analysis platforms (e.g. HCP Pipeline and Workbench, FreeSurfer, SPM, FSL, AFNI, etc.).
Strong programming skills and comfort with diverse computing environments (Linux) required.
Strong background in statistics and statistical software scripting (R, Python preferred).
Strong background creating scientific figures and writing technical scientific reports.
Strong interpersonal skills and a high level of organization with careful attention to detail are absolutely required. This position requires a high degree of motivation and self‐sufficiency, although extensive training and supervision will be provided.
